messages.content: What's the recipe to cook five chicken

function.name: recipe_calculator_calculate_time
function.description: Calculates the time to cook a recipe based on weight and per unit time. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

weight.description: The weight of the item to be cooked. This is a float type value.

per_unit_time.description: The time required to cook per unit weight.

unit_of_time.description: Unit of time, such as minutes or hours. Default is minutes.

We can give a general recipe: roast five whole chickens. Provide ingredients, steps, cooking time. Also mention cooking time calculation. We can use the function to calculate cooking time: weight of each chicken? We don't know weight. We can assume average weight of a whole chicken is about 1.5 kg. So total weight 7.5 kg. Per unit time maybe 45 minutes per kg? Actually typical roasting time is about 20 minutes per pound (0.45 kg) plus 10 minutes. Let's approximate: 45 minutes per kg. So 7.5 kg * 45 min = 337.5 min ~ 5.6 hours. But we can give approximate. Or we can ask for weight. But we can provide a general recipe with approximate times.

We can also use the function to calculate time: weight=7.5, per_unit_time=45, unit_of_time="minutes". Let's do that.
